program.name: Honours Bachelor of Information Sciences — Cybersecurity

courses.name: Introduction to Programming
courses.description: Fundamentals of programming using Python. Variables, control flow, functions, and basic data structures.

courses.name: Discrete Mathematics
courses.description: Logic, sets, relations, functions, combinatorics, and graph theory for computing.

courses.name: Professional Communications
courses.description: Written and oral communication skills for technology professionals.

courses.name: Data Structures and Algorithms
courses.description: Arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, sorting, and searching algorithms.

courses.name: Web Development Fundamentals
courses.description: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and introductory server-side development.

courses.name: Networking Fundamentals
courses.description: OSI model, TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network protocols.

courses.name: Database Systems
courses.description: Relational databases, SQL, normalization, indexing, and transaction management.

courses.name: Operating Systems
courses.description: Processes, memory management, file systems, and concurrency.

courses.name: Introduction to Cybersecurity
courses.description: Threat landscape, security principles, risk assessment, and compliance frameworks.

courses.name: Software Engineering
courses.description: SDLC, Agile, requirements, design patterns, testing, and version control.

courses.name: Network Security
courses.description: Firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, wireless security, and network hardening.

courses.name: Cloud Computing Fundamentals
courses.description: AWS/Azure fundamentals, IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, virtualization, and containers.

courses.name: Statistics for Data Science
courses.description: Probability, distributions, hypothesis testing, regression, and statistical inference.

courses.name: Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing
courses.description: Reconnaissance, scanning, exploitation, post-exploitation, and reporting.

courses.name: Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals
courses.description: Search, knowledge representation, ML fundamentals, and neural networks.

courses.name: Cloud Security Architecture
courses.description: IAM, encryption, compliance, security monitoring, and incident response in cloud.

courses.name: Digital Forensics
courses.description: Evidence collection, disk forensics, memory forensics, and chain of custody.

courses.name: Secure Application Development
courses.description: OWASP Top 10, secure coding, threat modeling, and security testing.

courses.name: Machine Learning
courses.description: Supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, feature engineering.

courses.name: DevOps and CI/CD
courses.description: Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, infrastructure as code.

courses.name: GenAI Security
courses.description: LLM security, prompt injection, agent frameworks, AI risk assessment.

courses.name: Capstone Project I
courses.description: Industry-partnered project: proposal, design, and initial implementation.

courses.name: Capstone Project II
courses.description: Industry-partnered project: implementation, testing, deployment, and presentation.

courses.name: Governance, Risk, and Compliance
courses.description: ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2, privacy regulations, and audit processes.

courses.name: Advanced Cloud Architecture
courses.description: Multi-region, serverless, microservices, cost optimization, and HA/DR.

courses.name: Introduction to Business
courses.description: Business fundamentals, entrepreneurship, and technology commercialization.

courses.name: Project Management
courses.description: Agile and waterfall PM, scheduling, budgeting, and stakeholder management.

courses.name: Technical Writing
courses.description: Documentation standards, API docs, user guides, and report writing.
